select id, username, email, phone, avatar, role from fresh_system.user where is_deleted = false
and role = #{role}
and username like '%${search}%'
order by create_time desc

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.role, u.nick_name "nickName", u.account, u.avatar, u.birthday, u.email, u.phone,
a.id AS "addressID", a.name AS "addressName", a.phone AS "addressPhone", a.province, a.city, a.district, a.detailed_address AS "detailedAddress", a.create_time AS "createTime", a.update_time AS "updateTime" FROM user u LEFT JOIN user_address ua ON u.id = ua.user_id AND ua.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN address a ON ua.shipping_address_id = a.id WHERE u.id = #{userId}
